body:
The generated-code check needs a follow-up before its result can be marked passed.

At commit `45e6bb266d`, the `savek2-20261008` run records `main-side=0 helper-side=0 save_k_helper=0` for every generated file in `tests-savek2.txt`. The script selected those files because they contain `save_k<` (calls to the function that stores attention keys). The zero counts therefore do not establish that each operation has both required calls.

Please count complete `save_k` calls and classify their final two arguments. Compare the main and helper counts with the number of operations that write keys and values. Record the corrected counts in the PR results. This is a validation gap, not a demonstrated code defect.

body:
Done. The counting method in the script was wrong, not the generated code. The pattern `k, *0, *n_workers` assumed the K variable is named `k` (as in the generator test). The real plugins name it `rope_N`, so every count came out 0.

Corrected count at 45e6bb266d (VNNI build, plugin headers under `gen/src/tron/h/tron/plugins/`): every `save_k<...>(...);` call is classified by its last two arguments. The count of `save_v<...>(...);` calls gives the number of KV-writing operations (the generator emits one `save_v` per KV-writing operation, on the main side only). Result for each of the 19 plugins:

- main-side `save_k` calls (`0, n_workers`) = helper-side `save_k` calls (`worker_ix, n_workers`) = `save_v` calls. Examples: qwen3-4b 36 / 36 / 36, qwen3-30b-moe 48 / 48 / 48, gpt-oss-120b 36 / 36 / 36.
- no `save_k` call has any other last two arguments.
- no plugin names `save_k_helper`.

The PR description records the per-plugin counts (Test section: the "generated plugin text" row and the table under the results). The raw table is `exec/results/savek2-20261008/plugin-calls.txt` in jhan's intel-AMX workspace.

Verified at `45e6bb266d`. I independently parsed the generated headers in the tested build on delphi-3bda. All 19 plugins have matching main and helper `save_k` calls (key saves) for the operations targeted by `save_v` (value saves). Every call has the expected final worker arguments. None names the removed helper function.

I also checked the recorded results for both layouts, the Haskell suite, and the format checks. They pass. The control run with matrix instructions disabled reports its three expected skipped instruction checks.

The corrected PR results address this finding. I am resolving the thread and closing the initial review.
